name: Quantity Selector
summary: Editable native quantity spinbutton with named step actions, form constraints, read-only and disabled behavior, and target-owned inventory persistence.

anatomy.name: innerSpinButton
anatomy.description: Generated WebKit spin button hidden by the CSS adapter.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Quantity that needs attention without being invalid.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default quantity button and input size.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state that preserves the active validation color family.

states.name: focusWithin
states.description: Shared inner border and outer focus ring when a control inside the selector has focus.

states.name: buttonHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on increment or decrement buttons.

states.name: buttonDisabled
states.description: Derived unavailable state when the value reaches a boundary or the whole field is disabled.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable selector state driven by the native input disabled attribute.

states.name: readOnly
states.description: Focusable and submittable native value with both step actions unavailable.

states.name: spinButtonsHidden
states.description: Native WebKit spin buttons hidden by the CSS adapter.

behavior.name: nativeNumber
behavior.description: The input preserves native number semantics, live editing, constraints, form ownership, and mobile keyboard support.

behavior.name: incrementDecrement
events: ArrowUp and ArrowDown on the native field
behavior.description: Shared progressive enhancement calls native stepDown or stepUp, emits input and change only when value changes, and preserves native keyboard stepping.

behavior.name: buttonAvailability
behavior.description: Progressive enhancement disables decrement and increment at their respective boundaries and disables both when the field is disabled or read-only.

behavior.name: validationComposition
behavior.description: The selector owns validation treatment for its control; a composing field wrapper owns visible label and feedback text.

behavior.name: valueOwnership
attributes: value establishes the initial value in static HTML
live value or defaultValue in framework adapters
behavior.description: The native input is the sole quantity owner; buttons and adapters never maintain a hidden mirror value.

behavior.name: stepFallback
attributes: invalid or non-positive step falls back to 1
behavior.description: Adapters preserve HTML step-base alignment and normalize unsupported step input without expanding the public API.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Initial quantity represented by the native number field; native Web owns subsequent editing and framework adapters may bind the live value.

properties.name: min
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit min when the target has no lower quantity boundary.
properties.description: Optional minimum quantity used by native validation and step-button availability.

properties.name: max
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit max when the target has no upper quantity boundary.
properties.description: Optional maximum quantity used by native validation and step-button availability.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Positive increment used by native and enhanced stepping; absent, invalid, or non-positive values fall back to one.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation selected from the canonical variant list.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the native field and both step buttons unavailable.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native form field name used when the quantity participates in submission.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires a non-empty valid numeric quantity through native constraint validation; a composing visible Field Wrapper label shows the standardized decorative marker, while accessible-name-only targets do not invent a visible label.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Keeps the value focusable and submittable while preventing typing and both step actions.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the native quantity field.

properties.name: decrementLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the decrement button.

properties.name: incrementLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the increment button.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit aria-describedby when no external feedback is composed.
properties.description: Id of external supporting or validation feedback associated with the field.

accessibility: Provide a visible label or equivalent accessible name for the quantity input.
Name increment and decrement buttons clearly.
Respect min, max, step, disabled, and inventory constraints.
Do not rely on hidden browser spin buttons as the only way to change the value.
Keep typed values and button updates synchronized through the sole native input.
Read-only quantity remains focusable and submittable while decrement and increment are unavailable.
Use native input and change events for controlled adapters and preserve form reset behavior.

web.notes: Canonical CSS and shared progressive enhancement preserve native step alignment, form/value ownership, validation, boundaries, read-only, and state synchronization.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render the quantity control and target JavaScript should synchronize cart quantity changes.
